features.help: Used with weight to calculate BMI.

features.name: weight_kg

features.name: cycle_regularity
features.label: Menstrual cycle regularity
features.help: Regular means your period arrives roughly the same number of days apart, cycle after cycle.

features.name: period_duration_days
features.label: Period duration
features.help: How many days you typically bleed for, not the gap between periods.

excluded_from_model: family_history — not present in the source dataset; do not fabricate it.
All hormone panels (AMH, FSH, LH, TSH, PRL, PRG, beta-HCG, RBS) — lab-only.
Follicle counts / sizes, endometrium thickness — ultrasound-only.
Blood pressure, pulse, respiratory rate, Hb — clinical-visit-only.
